features.title: Bounded compaction summaries
features.summary: Summarizes oversized conversation history in bounded, tool-balanced requests before the native durable compaction transaction commits.
failureModes: A system prompt, tool catalog, or one indivisible tool transaction can exceed the safe request budget; compaction fails without rewriting the session history.
An image-bearing request without model-declared image pricing cannot be safely sized and fails before dispatch.

verification.testName: splits oversized input while keeping tool calls with their results

verification.reason: This Host-only backend has no browser-owned surface; its behavior is verified through unit tests and a scratch profile boot.

features.title: Idle compaction before cache expiry
features.summary: An opt-in Host timer compacts a large thread that has sat idle for most of its prompt-cache lifetime, so the next message does not re-send the whole prompt uncached. Off by default: each compaction is one billed request.

configuration.constraints: A compaction is one billed request per idle thread; turn it on only after a measurement.
A thread below this prompt size is left alone.
The cache lifetime the thread's route asks for; 60 with cacheRetention long.
How long before the lifetime ends to compact.

failureModes: The sweep lists the newest 200 visible threads; a larger history leaves older threads alone until they move back into that window.
A running thread is skipped and retried on a later sweep; a compaction command that fails is logged and retried.
A cold thread's idle start is the thread list's updatedAt (its last human prompt), so a thread whose long turn just finished can look idle slightly early.

features.title: Next automatic compaction for a thread
features.summary: The threshold API (agent tool compaction_threshold) returns the token count at which automatic compaction next runs for one live thread: the running engine's policy, the thread's routed model and context window, its output reservation, and the engine's own pressure reading. agent-plan shows it beside the composer's context meter.
features.currentSurface: host: threshold API and agent tool
failureModes: The route's model info lookup can fail; the API returns compaction-threshold-failure naming the route to fix in Settings › Models.

verification.testName: reads the running engine policy, the routed output cap and the meter for a live thread

verification.reason: This Host API has no browser surface of its own; the agent-plan.compaction-meter journey drives it through the agent-plan chip.
